name: Content Moderation & Abuse Prevention
description: Cross-cutting controls to prevent abuse across public and authenticated surfaces: rate limiting, CAPTCHA/Turnstile, spam detection, reporting flows, moderation actions, and auditability. Covers comments, inquiries, invitations RSVP, share links, and upload abuse.
goals: Protect public endpoints from spam, credential stuffing, brute force, and scraping.
Provide consistent reporting and moderation workflows.
Minimize false positives while maintaining platform safety.
Maintain strong audit trail for all moderation actions.
nonGoals: Full trust & safety machine learning suite (start with rules + signals; ML optional).
Replacing WAF capabilities (Cloudflare WAF remains primary network defense).

rules: Abuse reports are workspace-scoped unless they concern platform-wide threats.
Moderation actions must be attributed to workspace_id and actor.
Public actors are represented by share_link_session_id, IP, and user-agent (sanitized).

actors.name: Public Actor
actors.description: Guest user interacting via share links.

workflows.name: Public Endpoint Protection
steps: Apply edge + app-level rate limiting (per IP + per share link token hash).
Use Turnstile on sensitive public mutations (RSVP, inquiries, abuse report, login).
Detect brute force (asset access codes/passwords) with backoff and temporary bans.
Record risk signals; auto-escalate to platform admin when thresholds are exceeded.

workflows.name: Moderation Review & Action
steps: Staff/admin reviews report, evidence, and associated activity.
Take action: hide/delete content, block identity/IP, resolve report.
Notify reporter (optional) and log moderation action to audit.
Maintain a reversible state where possible (hide/unhide), but allow permanent delete for severe abuse.

controls: Audit logs for all moderation actions.
PII-safe storage of IP (store hashed IP, keep raw only in edge logs if needed).
CSRF protection on authenticated surfaces; strict CORS for APIs.
Separation between workspace moderation and platform-level enforcement.

traces: Public mutation spans with enforcement decisions

acceptanceTests: Public RSVP and inquiry endpoints are rate limited and Turnstile-protected when enabled.
Brute forcing access codes triggers backoff and blocks further attempts.
Moderation actions are auditable and reversible where applicable.
